given'' | {{List| * {{SSHD}} * {{EoW}} * {{AoC}} * {{AoI}} }} }} ==Appearances== ==={{ALttP|-}}=== In {{ALttP}}, Fish can be captured when the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] is drained out of the small pond in the [[Great Swamp]] in the [[Light World]]. If this Fish is thrown back into the water, it will thank [[Link]] and give him some [[Rupee]]s. However, the hero can also carry the Fish to the [[Street Merchant]] in [[Kakariko Village]] in exchange for 21 Rupees, 10 [[Arrow]]s, 8 [[Bomb]]s, and a [[Magic Jar]]. Fish is also the answer to the fourth riddle given by [[Q. Bumpkin]]. ==={{LA|-}}=== {{Main|[[Fishing#Link's Awakening|Fishing in Link's Awakening]]}} In {{LA}}, Fish can be caught in a [[Fishing]] [[Mini-Game]] in [[Mabe Village]]. The Fish come in two sizes, where big ones are called "lunkers" and little ones "runts". One of the lunkers gives Link a [[Piece of Heart]]. Link also encounters several Fish enemies in {{LA|-}}, including [[Piranha]]s, [[Cheep-Cheep]]s, and the [[Angler Fish]]. ==={{OoT|-}}=== {{Main|[[Fishing#Ocarina of Time|Fishing in Ocarina of Time]]}} In {{OoT}}, small Fish can be captured in [[Bottle]]s, and are needed to gain entrance to [[Lord Jabu-Jabu]]'s [[Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly|belly]]. Fish can be scooped into a Bottle in [[Zora's Domain]], or alternately bought at the [[Medicine Shop]] or the [[Zora Shop]] for 200 Rupees. Bottled Fish can also be sold to the [[Buyer]] for 100 Rupees. A [[Fishing]] [[Mini-Game]] can also be played in the [[Fishing Pond]] in [[Lake Hylia]]. Link can obtain various prizes for catching a record-size Fish and showing it to the [[Fishing Hole Man]]. ====List of Fish==== {{Data Table |game= OoT |columns= Fish [Image:Model:120px][Link], Notes [Description] |- | Hyrule Bass | The biggest Hyrule Bass can always be found next to the log on the western part of the pond. |- | Hyrule Loach | Can only be caught when located below the [[Lily Pad]]s. }} ==={{MM|-}}=== In {{MM}}, Fish can be captured in [[Bottle]]s and may be sold to the [[Curiosity Shop]]. Two carnivorous Fish can also be found in a fish tank in the [[Marine Research Lab]]. [[Link]] can feed these carnivorous Fish with other small Fish he has bottled, causing them to grow in size. Once one of the two has grown four times, it will eat the other and spit out a [[Piece of Heart]] for Link to collect. [[Seahorse]]s can also be found in the [[Great Bay]], and are regarded as a rare species by some. In {{MM3D}}, two [[Fishing Hole]]s were added. These include the [[Swamp Fishing Hole]] on the [[Road to Southern Swamp]], and the [[Ocean Fishing Hole]] in [[Zora Cape]]. Link can wear various [[Mask]] and play certain [[Song]]s to attract certain species of Fish. 12 different species of Fish can be caught in each Fishing Hole. ====List of Fish in the Swamp Fishing Hole==== {{Gallery List|Creatures |MM3D= Ancient Fish, Colossal Catfish, Cuccofish, Ferocious Pirarucu, Fragrant Reekfish, Groovy Carp, Lord Chapu-Chapu, Mooranha, Postal Salmon, Sweet Ranchfish, Termina Bass, Termina Loach }} {{Data Table |game= MM3D |caption= Additional information |collapse= true |columns= Fish [Image:Model:120px][Link], Days, Time, Lure, Notes [Description] |- | Ancient Fish | All | All | Sinking | Appears in the north portion, close to the cave. Vulnerable to catch while wearing the [[Captain's Hat]]. |- | Termina Seabass | All | All | Standard | Appears close to the shore. }} ==={{OoS|-}}=== In {{OoS}}, the Fish is the sixth [[Item]] in the [[Trading Game]]. It is a small blue Fish that is given to Link by [[Ingo]] in exchange for helping complete his [[Pot]] collection with the [[Goron Vase]], which was always refused to him by [[Biggoron]]. This Fish is passed on to an [[Old Man]] trying to get his [[Cat]], [[Mittens]], down from a [[Tree]] in the [[Eyeglass Lake]] in return for the [[Megaphone]]. {{clear}} ==={{TP|-}}=== {{Main|[[Fishing#Twilight Princess|Fishing in Twilight Princess]]}} In {{TP}}, Fish can be caught from nearly every body of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] using the [[Fishing Rod]]. Records of Fish that have been caught by [[Bobber Fishing]] are stored in the [[Fish Journal]] along with the size and amount of each specific Fish. Whenever a Fish is thrown back into the Water, it will leave behind a [[Heart]]. In addition to the regular Bobber Fishing, Link can also [[Fishing|Fish]] using [[Lure]]s at [[Hena's Fishing Hole]]. A Fish must be caught at the beginning of the game using the Fishing Rod in order to get [[Sera]]'s [[Cat]] to return to [[Sera's Sundries]], her shop. Later on, a Fish called the [[Reekfish]] must be caught using the [[Coral Lure]] in [[Zora's Domain]] to reach [[Snowpeak]]. [[Wolf Link]] can use his [[Sense]]s to track the Fish's [[Reekfish Scent|Scent]], allowing him to navigate Snowpeak without getting lost in its [[Blizzard]]. The [[Skullfish]] and [[Bombfish]] enemies are two forbidden Fish that can be caught but will not be recorded in the Fish Journal. Catching a Skullfish can yield a Heart like other Fish. The Bombfish will add a [[Water Bomb]] to Link's inventory. ====List of Fish==== {{Gallery List|Creatures |TP= Bombfish, Greengill, Hylian Pike, Hyrule Bass, Hylian Loach, Ordon Catfish, Reekfish, Skullfish }} {{Data Table |game= TP |caption= Additional information |collapse= true |columns= Fish [Image:Model:120px][Link], Lure, Notes [Description] |- | Bombfish | N/A | Bobber Fishing only. Forbidden. }} ==={{PH|-}}=== {{Main|[[Fishing#Phantom Hourglass|Fishing in Phantom Hourglass]]}} In {{PH}}, Link can fish off [[Linebeck]]'s boat provided he has obtained the Fishing Rod from the [[Old Wayfarer]]. There are six types of Fish available. If Link manages to catch a Neptoona, he will be rewarded with a [[Heart Container]] from the Old Wayfarer. ====List of Fish==== {{Gallery List|Creatures |PH= Loovar, Neptoona, Rusty Swordfish, Skippyjack, Stowfish, Toona }} {{Data Table |game= PH |caption= Additional information |collapse= true |columns= Fish [Image:Model:120px][Link], Lure, Notes [Description] |- | Loovar | Standard | May also bring a Stowfish attached to its belly when caught. |- | Neptoona | Big Catch Lure | May also bring a Stowfish attached to its belly when caught. |- | Rusty Swordfish | Big Catch Lure | Rarely found in smaller Fish shadows, but are often found in the larger Swordfish shadows on the [[World of the Ocean King|sea]].
May also bring a Stowfish attached to its belly when caught. |- | Skippyjack | Standard | Mostly found on the southwest area of the sea. |- | Stowfish | Standard | May be found attached to a Toona, Loovar, Rusty Swordfish, or Neptoona. |- | Toona | Standard | May also bring a Stowfish attached to its belly when caught. }} ==={{ST|-}}=== {{Main|Loovar, Neptoona, Rusty Swordfish, Skippyjack, Toboni, Toona}} Many species of Fish inhabit the [[Water (Terrain)|Waters]] of the [[Ocean Realm]], most of them also present in the [[World of the Ocean King]]. Most cannot be interacted with, but [[Toboni]] can be bought from [[Niboshi]] in [[Papuchia Village]] and transported as [[Cargo]]. ==={{SS|-}}=== {{Main|Eelie, Waroana}} Small Fish known as [[Eelie]] and [[Waroana]] can be found in the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] of the [[Faron Province]]. They cannot be interacted with, and will flee if [[Link]] approaches them. ====List of Fish==== {{Gallery List|Creatures |SS= Eelie, Waroana }} ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, Fish can be found in various bodies of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. A Fishing Rod is not necessary to catch them, as they can simply be picked up while [[Swimming]], regardless of whether they are alive or dead. [[Link]] can eat them raw for minor health recovery, but they can also be cooked into various recipes which can restore many more Hearts. They will flee from Link if he approaches them. ====List of Fish==== {{Gallery List|Creatures|fileType= Icon |BotW= Armored Carp, Armored Porgy, Chillfin Trout, Hearty Bass, Hearty Salmon, Hyrule Bass, Mighty Carp, Mighty Porgy, Sanke Carp, Sizzlefin Trout, Staminoka Bass, Stealthfin Trout, Voltfin Trout }} {{Heading|level= 4|Additional information}} {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Materials in Breath of the Wild |storedAs= Fish |collapse= true }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== Fish are aquatic [[Creature]]s that can be found in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] throughout [[Hyrule]], the [[Depths]], and the [[Sky]]. [[Link]] can pick them up if he is close enough to one of them. The [[Surface]] is populated by [[Bass]], [[Carp]], [[Porgy|Porgies]], [[Salmon]], and [[Trout]]. [[Glowing Cave Fish]] can be found in [[Cave]]s and [[Well]]s on the Surface as well as in the Depths, and [[Ancient Arowana]]s can be found in pools of Water in the Sky. ====List of Fish==== {{Gallery List|Creatures |TotK= Ancient Arowana, Armored Carp, Armored Porgy, Chillfin Trout, Glowing Cave Fish, Hearty Bass, Hearty Salmon, Hyrule Bass, Mighty Carp, Mighty Porgy, Sanke Carp, Sizzlefin Trout, Staminoka Bass, Stealthfin Trout, Voltfin Trout }} {{Heading|level= 4|Additional information}} {{Data Table Copy |fromPage= Materials in Tears of the Kingdom |storedAs= TotK Materials |excludeColumns= Category |rowsWith= Fish |collapse= true }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Stub|EoW}} Fish can be found in bodies of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] and in some homes, but cannot be interacted with. ==Other Appearances== ==={{OoA|-}} (Himekawa)=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[Link]] follows [[Sir Raven]] to find the knight [[Fishing]]. When a Fish bites the knight's fishing line, he tells Link to get him a net. Link scoops the Fish into the net. Raven points out the Fish's features and says Fish like it are good to eat. Sir Raven brings the Fish to the [[Hidden Village#Oracle of Ages (Himekawa)|Hidden Village]] and gives it to the elder as a present. The elder tells Resuta to cook it right away. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} [[File:CoH Fish Sprite.png|left]] If [[Cadence]], [[Link]], [[Yves]], or [[Princess Zelda]] uses an [[Empty Bottle]] over a tile of bubbling [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they will catch one of three types of Fish. Fish will restore one [[Heart]], [[Big Fish]] will restore five Hearts along with some [[Stamina]], and [[Golden Fish]] will completely refill their hearts and restore Stamina. {{Noncanon|End}}
